newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan three-month NCD average yield at 5.879 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan three-month NCD average yield at 5.879 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank issued T$5 billion in three-month negotiable certificates of deposit on Friday at an average yield of 5.879 percent, a central bank official said.
The range of the bids was between 5.800 and 5.900 percent.

The central bank repeatedly issued NCDs during a sustained stock rally in March and April, a move widely seen as aiming to keep a lid on the loose liquidity that many experts said had been fuelling the sizzling stock market.
